title: mereyyah karaaratih daala
intro: taswiir baxxo le baaxoh gadda kee qaxmaqaane ayro elle qibaadah aftok tet gineenit. Ayyufta gufteh tan seeco quukak too habbaltam duude wayta, kee safar qimmiseh cokmih buxa fan nabah faxe naharal tumbulle. tokkel, soonoona intiita duquurussah tan baaxal qaddooweleeh, qaddoysiyyi uddur kullim milaagele.
clues: Anu ummatta Yallih aftok ayroh sujuudih abte leedale baaxo miraacise.
Anu kaxxa ayyufta yoh seeceh inni fayya haam hinnay Yallih rammit amaatuh.
Anu inni mala buxal walaleh, naharak diplomaasi doorite, ruube num gibbatuh acwa ruube.
Anu Sulaymaan fan emeeteeh, inni kursi yoh xayyooweh suge, yi mamaxxaga gibbatuh.
Anu fayyale daala cule too xabcin karaaratih baaxal anu hoxeh addah leet.
Anu suleymaan luk abeh an tabsiyyi Yallah, ginook Rabbih.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Baddi addat yan kaxxa kullumti yanxuqeh
Liggiditteh biyak kee buxâ marih wayti yumuttuke
Kicinto alqi soonoh addat fida kah yakkennah amrisen
uqrat tan qarkaytoo kee mereyya daala gibbatteh
trial.answer: uqrat tan qarkaytoo kee mereyya daala gibbatteh

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Yi gadda lih ardi yanxuqeh suge
Suleymaan luk tabsaanam Yallay Qaalam Rabbiy.
Baddi addat kak culeeh, mu'miniin kattaata wak.
Sabti ayro yaggileenimih taagah xaa fan korsen
outcome.answer: Suleymaan luk tabsaanam Yallay Qaalam Rabbiy.

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
